placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Inside the historic house at Blaise, everyday objects invite children to imagine life before familiar modern conveniences. Explore how people dressed, played and tackled jobs around the home.

Our family idea: choose one household task and compare how it was done then with how your family does it now. Afterwards, make time for a walk or playground visit in the surrounding estate.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families interested in toys, homes and everyday history.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Historic-house displays, with estate play areas and a cafe nearby.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use the Blaise Estate parking areas and check charges and gate times.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: The museum opens on selected days and seasonally. Check opening and access information before travelling, especially with a buggy.
